description: This file defines the 'Cod' class within the Opencart admin payment extension. It handles displaying and saving configuration settings for the Cash on Delivery payment method, including managing breadcrumbs, loading language strings, rendering views, and updating settings.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class managing the admin interface for the Cash on Delivery payment method configuration within Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the Cash on Delivery payment method in the admin panel, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, form data, and including header, footer, and other common components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to save configuration settings for the payment method, including permission checks and returning success or error status in JSON format.
